workspace.heroDescription: Arrange worldview, story, characters, and execution parameters into an observable, replayable authoring graph. Each result is saved as a candidate first and written to the project only after confirmation.
workspace.heroFooter: After running a node, confirm adoption before running downstream nodes; templates do not auto-write project data.
workspace.legacyBanner: This graph comes from FLOW-{{version}}. The canvas has been loaded with compatibility rules; saving will upgrade it to a domain node graph without rewriting the original project canon.

workspace.snapshotEmpty: Select a run node to view its actual inputs.
workspace.candidateEmpty: Select a run node to view candidate output.

toast.legacyConvertFailed: Legacy node graph could not be converted: {{message}}. The original graph was not modified.
toast.saveFailed: Save failed: {{message}}; the original graph was not modified.
toast.chainCreated: Full authoring chain created. Run upstream to downstream and confirm adoption step by step.
toast.deleteConfirmMessage: The node graph and all of its run inputs/outputs will be deleted permanently.
toast.deleteSuccess: Node graph and its run records deleted.
toast.runCompleted: Node graph run complete; candidates saved.
toast.runPaused: Run paused; resume from run history.
toast.alignNeedTwo: Alignment requires at least two nodes.

worldFoundation.name: World foundation
worldFoundation.description: Build a reusable world base from nature, culture, rules, and artifacts.

longNovel.name: Long novel
longNovel.description: Complete long-form pipeline covering world, story, characters, volumes & chapters, detailed outline, and prose.

shortNovel.name: Short novel
shortNovel.description: Compact creation chain with one volume and three chapters, keeping the same confirmation boundary.

characterDriven.name: Character-driven
characterDriven.description: Put characters, relationships, and character arcs ahead of volume/chapter structure in planning.

multiLineNarrative.name: Multi-line narrative
multiLineNarrative.description: Plan main plot, character subplots, and world subplots in parallel before converging into volume outlines.

chapterContinuationReview.name: Chapter continuation & review
chapterContinuationReview.description: Explicitly gathers previous chapter, handoff, summaries, related passages, and consistency report.

creationChain.missingNodeTemplate: Full creation chain missing node template: {{templateId}}

executor.runRecordCorrupted: Node run record corrupted; cannot serve as resume or rerun baseline.
executor.projectSourceNotSelected: Project source node has no source selected.
executor.ragBindingMissing: Project source node uses exact selection but has no fields bound.
executor.freeGenerationMissingInstruction: Free generation node missing authoring instruction.
executor.liveBindingReadOnly: Live Canon binding node is read-only; adopt downstream candidates instead.
executor.targetUpdatedElsewhere: Target content was updated in another mode or entry; rerun the node before adopting to avoid overwriting.
executor.noWritableContract: This node has no registered adoptable write contract.
executor.characterDimensionUnbound: Character dimension nodes need a bound target character to avoid writing to the wrong character.
executor.collectionCandidateInvalidJson: Collection candidates must be valid JSON; edit as JSON before adopting.
executor.noRunnableNodes: The current execution plan has no nodes to run.
executor.resumeRunMissing: Run record to resume does not exist or does not belong to the current graph.
executor.resumeOnlyPausedOrFailed: Only paused or failed runs can be resumed.
executor.graphChangedCannotResume: The graph has changed; cannot continue from the old checkpoint. Start a new run.
executor.noNodesToResume: This run has no pending nodes to resume.
executor.staleBaseMissing: Stale rerun baseline does not exist or does not belong to the current graph.
